title: Disparity
summary: DISPARITY, noun [Latin] 1. Irregularity; difference in degree, in age, rank, condition or excellence; as a disparity of year or of age; disparity of condition or circumstances; followed by of or in. W

inlines.v: DISPARITY, noun [Latin] 1. Irregularity; difference in degree, in age, rank, condition or excellence; as a disparity of year or of age; disparity of condition or circumstances; followed by of or in. We say, disparity in or of years. 2. Dissimilitude; unlikeness.
